title: 第25章 灵炉炼灵丹第24章 二小姐剑碑悟剑
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
今日，大概也只能参了。
因为三日后那场战斗转眼即至。
多参悟一分是一分吧……
留下半日时间拿来跟兄长沟通，也够了。
她刚刚来到剑碑之前，刚刚盘腿坐下……
突然，她全身大震！
剑碑之中，突然出现了一把剑，一剑出，天地空，无边的剑意喷薄而出，每一分每一寸，都是如此的明显，如此的触动人心。
一个瞬间，西门二丝就踏入玄而又玄的境界，浑然忘我……
她没空去思考这是为什么。
圣女峰上，没有人知道发生了什么。
只有度凌自己知道，他做了一件事。
现阶段唯一能做的一件事。
那就是用仙气，悄悄刺激这面剑碑。
这剑碑很特殊，先祖剑意，深深藏入碑中，一般情况下，坐而参悟，只能触摸到这道剑意的皮毛。
然而，他的仙气一至。
这股封存千年的剑意感受到了莫大的威胁，被彻底激活……
这一激活，对于碑前参悟的西门二丝而言，有一个专业名词叫：“剑意具像”。
何意？
剑意具像化了！
就像平日里只能闻到一缕缥缈的花香，参悟之人感悟这缕花香，揣摩着花儿的形态，但突然之间，帘幕拉开了，花的真容直接显现……

度凌微微一笑，转身从剑碑之前离开，来到了外面的平台。
平台之上，几个服侍圣女的弟子望着他，一时丧失了言语功能。
圣女峰，没有男弟子。
平素里，除了圣子和长老之外，也几乎没有男人登临。
但今日，突然来了一个。
这男人很年轻，身上感受不到任何修行人的气息。
但是，他是二小姐手牵手儿带上山的。
看这牵手的程度给了众位弟子很狂野的想象……
山峰上大家不便于讨论，只敢在内心疯狂揣摩的事儿，还真的有可能是真的……
圣女峰顶，圣女西门一丝静静地站在窗前，盯着这条潇洒的身影，走下她的圣女峰。
身后风声轻轻一响，传来西门三丝的气息。
西门三丝道：“大姐，你真得管管了，二姐太不成事了……”
西门一丝幽幽吐口气：“你倒是早点跟我说啊，现在才说，生米都煮成熟饭了，不是迟了吗？”
content_en:
Today, I probably can only participate.
Because the battle is coming in three days.
The more you understand, the more you gain...
It's enough to leave half a day to communicate with my brother.
She just came to the sword monument and sat down cross-legged...
Suddenly, her whole body was shaken!
In the sword monument, a sword suddenly appeared. When the sword came out, the sky and the earth were filled with boundless sword intent. Every inch and every inch was so obvious and so touching.
In an instant, Ximen Ersi stepped into a mysterious and mysterious realm, completely forgetting herself...
She didn't have time to think about why.
On the Saintess Peak, no one knew what happened.
Only Du Ling himself knew that he had done something.
The only thing that can be done at this stage.
That is to use fairy energy to quietly stimulate this sword monument.
This sword stele is very special. The sword intention of the ancestors is deeply hidden in the stele. Under normal circumstances, one can only touch the surface of this sword intention while sitting and meditating.
However, his immortality arrived.
This sword intent that had been sealed for thousands of years felt a great threat and was completely activated...
This activation, for Ximen Ersi who meditated in front of the monument, has a professional term called: "concrete image of sword intention".
What do you mean?
The sword intention has become concrete!
Just like on ordinary days, one can only smell a wisp of misty floral fragrance. The person who is enlightened feels this wisp of floral fragrance and speculates on the shape of the flower. But suddenly, the curtain opens, and the true appearance of the flower is directly revealed...
Du Ling smiled slightly, turned around and left in front of the sword monument, arriving at the platform outside.
On the platform, several disciples serving the saint looked at him and lost the ability to speak for a moment.
There are no male disciples at Saintess Peak.
Normally, except for the Holy Son and the elders, there are almost no men here.
But today, one suddenly came.
This man was very young and could not feel any aura of a cultivator on his body.
However, it was the second lady who took him up the mountain hand in hand.
The extent of holding hands gave all the disciples wild imaginations...
It is not convenient for people to discuss things on the mountain peaks, and they only dare to speculate wildly in their hearts. It is really possible that it is true...
On the top of Saintess' Peak, Saint Ximen stood quietly in front of the window, staring at this handsome figure as she walked down her Saintess' Peak.
There was a soft sound of wind behind him, and Ximen Sansi's breath came.
Ximen Sansi said: "Eldest sister, you really need to take care of yourself. Second sister is too unruly..."
Ximen sighed faintly: "You should have told me earlier. Isn't it too late to tell me now that the raw rice has already been cooked?"
